37:1: By those lined up in ranks.
37:2: By those who drive and restrain.
37:3: By those who recite the Dhikr.
37:5: Rabb of the heavens and the earth and what is between the two, and Rabb of the easts.
37:6: Surely We adorned the lowest heaven with an adornment, the stars.
37:7: And We protected it from every rebellious devil.
37:8: They cannot listen to the exalted assembly, and they are pelted from every side.
37:9: Driven away, and for them there is a perpetual punishment.
37:10: Except if someone snatches a snatch, a piercing flame pursues him.
37:11: Ask them: Are they stronger in creation, or those whom We created? Surely We created them from sticky clay.
37:12: Rather, you wondered, and they mock.
37:13: And when they are admonished, they do not take heed.
37:14: And when they see a sign, they mock.
37:15: They said: 'This is nothing but clear sorcery.'
37:16: Is it when we die and become dust and bones, will we indeed be resurrected?
37:18: Say: Yes, and you will be humiliated.
37:19: It is only a single cry, and at once they look on.
37:20: And they say: Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment.
37:21: This is the Day of Distinction which you used to deny.
37:22: Gather those who committed wrongdoing, their spouses, and what they used to worship.
37:23: Besides Allah, and lead them to the path of Hell.
37:24: Stop them, surely they will be questioned.
37:25: What is the matter with you that you do not help one another?
37:27: Some of them turn to others, asking.
37:28: They said: Surely it was you who used to come to us from the right.
37:29: They said: Rather, you were not believers.
37:30: And we had no authority over you. Rather, you were a transgressing people.
37:31: Thus the word of our Rabb has become true against us; surely we are tasters.
37:32: We led you astray, because we were deviated.
37:33: Surely on that day they are partners in the punishment.
37:34: Surely this is how We deal with the criminals.
37:35: Surely when it was said to them, 'There is no deity but Allah,' they used to be arrogant.
37:36: And they would say: 'Are we to leave our deities for a mad poet?'
37:37: No, he brought the truth and confirmed the messengers.
37:38: Surely you are tasters of the painful punishment.
37:39: And you are only recompensed for what you used to do.
37:40: Except the sincere servants of Allah.
37:41: For them there is a known provision.
37:45: A cup from a spring is circulated among them.
37:47: In it there is neither headache, nor are they intoxicated from it.
37:48: Beside them are those who restrain their glances, with large eyes.
37:49: As if they were sheltered white eggs.
37:50: Then some of them turn to others, asking.
37:51: A speaker from among them said: Surely I had a companion.
37:52: He would say: Are you also among those who confirm?
37:53: When we die and become dust and bones, will we really be brought to account?
37:55: He looks and sees him in the midst of Hell.
37:56: He said: 'By Allah, you had almost ruined me.'
37:57: If it were not for the favor of my Rabb, I certainly would have been among those brought forth.
37:59: Except our first death, and we will not be punished.
37:60: Surely this is the great salvation itself.
37:61: For the like of this let the workers work.
37:62: Is this a better hospitality, or the tree of Zaqqum?
37:63: Surely We made it a trial for the wrongdoers.
37:64: Surely it is a tree that emerges from the bottom of Hell.
37:65: Its shoots are as if they were the heads of devils.
37:66: Surely they eat from it and fill their bellies with it.
37:67: Then surely for them upon it is a mixture of boiling water.
37:68: Then surely their return is to Hell.
37:69: Surely they found their fathers astray.
37:70: So they are hastened along their footsteps.
37:71: And certainly most of the former people went astray before them.
37:72: And certainly We had sent warners among them.
37:73: Look how the end of those who were warned was.
37:74: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
37:75: And certainly Noah called upon Us, and how excellent are the responders.
37:76: And We delivered him and his family from the great distress.
37:77: And We made his offspring the survivors.
37:78: And We left upon him among the later generations.
37:79: Peace be upon Noah among the worlds.
37:80: Surely thus do We reward the doers of good.
37:81: Surely he was of Our believing servants.
37:83: And surely of his faction was Abraham.
37:84: When he came to his Rabb with a sound heart.
37:85: When he said to his father and his people: "What do you worship?"
37:86: Do you want fabricated deities besides Allah?
37:87: What is your thought concerning the Rabb of the worlds?
37:88: Thereupon Abraham cast a look at the stars.
37:89: Then he said: Surely I am ill.
37:90: Then they turned back from him, turning away.
37:91: Thereupon he turned to their deities and said: "Do you not eat?"
37:92: What is the matter with you that you do not speak?
37:93: Then he turned upon them, striking with the right hand.
37:94: Thereupon they came running to him.
37:95: He said: "Do you worship what you carve?"
37:96: While Allah created you and what you make.
37:97: They said: Build a structure for him, then throw him into Hell.
37:98: So they wanted to devise a plot against him, thereupon We made them the lowest.
37:99: And he said: "Surely I am going to my Rabb; He will guide me."
37:100: My Rabb, grant me from the righteous.
37:101: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
37:102: When he reached the age of striving with him, he said: "O my son, surely I see in a dream that I slaughter you. Look, what do you see?" He said: "O my father, do what you are commanded. Insha'Allah you will find me among the patient."
37:103: Thus when they both had surrendered and he laid him down upon his forehead.
37:104: We called out to him: 'O Abraham!'
37:105: You have indeed fulfilled the dream. Surely thus We reward the doers of good.
37:106: Surely this was a clear trial.
37:107: And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice.
37:108: And We left upon him among the later generations.
37:110: Thus do We reward the doers of good.
37:111: Surely he is of Our believing servants.
37:112: And We gave him the good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
37:113: And We blessed him and Isaac, and among the offspring of both is the doer of good, and one who clearly wrongs his own soul.
37:114: And certainly We bestowed favor upon Moses and Aaron.
37:115: And We delivered them and their people from the great distress.
37:116: And We helped them, and they became the victors.
37:117: And We gave both of them the clear Book.
37:118: And We guided both of them to the straight path.
37:119: And We left upon both of them among the later generations.
37:120: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
37:121: Indeed, thus We reward the doers of good.
37:122: Indeed, they are of Our believing servants.
37:123: And indeed, Elijah was of the messengers.
37:124: When he said to his people: "Will you not beware?"
37:125: Do you call upon Baal and leave the best of creators?
37:126: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
37:127: Thus they denied him, so indeed, they are to be brought forth.
37:128: Except the sincere servants of Allah.
37:129: And We left upon him among the later generations.
37:131: Indeed, thus We reward the doers of good.
37:132: Indeed, he is of Our believing servants.
37:133: And indeed, Lot was of those sent.
37:134: When We saved him and his family all together.
37:135: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
37:137: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning and at night.
37:138: And at night. Will you not then reason?
37:139: And indeed, Jonah was of those sent.
37:140: When he fled to the laden ship.
37:141: He drew lots and was of the losers.
37:142: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
37:143: Had he not been of those who glorify (Allah), he would surely have remained in its belly until the day they are resurrected.
37:144: He would surely have remained in its belly until the day they are resurrected.
37:145: We cast him onto an empty shore while he was sick.
37:146: And We caused a broad-leaved tree to grow over him.
37:147: And We sent him to a hundred thousand or more.
37:148: So they believed, and We granted them enjoyment for a time.
37:149: Ask them: are the daughters for your Lord, while the sons are for them?
37:150: Or did We create the angels females while they were witnesses?
37:151: Beware, indeed they say out of their own slander:
37:152: They say: "Allah has begotten;" indeed, they are liars.
37:153: Did He choose daughters over sons?
37:154: What is the matter with you, how do you judge?
37:156: Or do you have a clear proof?
37:157: Bring your book, if you are truthful.
37:158: And they invented a lineage between Him and the jinn. And certainly the jinn have known that they will be brought forth.
37:159: Allah is exalted above whatever they describe.
37:160: Except the sincerely chosen servants of Allah.
37:161: Indeed, you and what you worship cannot mislead (anyone) against Him, except him who will enter Hell.
37:163: You cannot seduce (anyone) except him who will enter Hell.
37:164: There is none among us but has a known station.
37:165: And indeed we, we are those who stand in ranks.
37:166: And indeed we, we are those who glorify (Him).
37:167: And indeed they used to say:
37:168: If only we had with us a reminder from the earlier peoples,
37:169: We would surely have been the sincere servants of Allah.
37:170: So they disbelieved in it, but soon they will know.
37:171: And certainly Our word had preceded to Our servant messengers:
37:172: Indeed, they are the ones who are helped,
37:173: And indeed Our armies, they will be the victorious.
37:174: So turn away from them for a time.
37:175: And watch them, so they too will see.
37:176: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
37:177: Whenever it descends into their courtyard, how evil will be the morning of those warned!
37:178: Turn away from them for a time.
37:179: And see, so they too will see.
37:180: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe.
37:181: And peace be upon the messengers.
37:182: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
